categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Anlogic Infotech Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, and sales of FPGA (Field-Programmable Gate Array) chips, FPSoC (Field Programmable System On Chip) chips, and dedicated EDA (Electronic Design Automation) software. Their product lines include multiple FPGA series (SALPHOENIX, SALEAGLE, SALELF) and FPSoC series (SALSWIFT, SALDRAGON), serving diverse applications such as industrial control, network communication, video image processing, automotive electronics, data centers, consumer electronics, medical devices, and new energy sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced FPGA and FPSoC chip hardware architecture, high-performance IP cores, proprietary EDA software algorithms, and chip testing technologies. They utilize a fabless model, outsourcing wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to third-party foundries. Their proprietary EDA software (TangDynasty for FPGA and FutureDynasty for FPSoC) supports full design flows, and they develop modular application IP and reference designs to accelerate customer product development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial control, network communication, video image processing, automotive electronics, data centers, consumer electronics, medical equipment, and new energy industries. The company serves mainly domestic clients through direct sales and distributors, with a growing customer base and deepening cooperation with leading industry players, especially in video processing and automotive sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and multiple branches in Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen, Jinan, and Chengdu. It also has wholly-owned subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Chengdu. The domestic market constitutes the majority of revenue, with some sales in Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anlogic operates as a fabless semiconductor company, focusing on chip design and development (upstream/midstream) while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries (downstream). They maintain close partnerships with key suppliers to ensure supply chain stability and quality.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology-driven innovation with significant R&D investment (over 54% of revenue). Strategic priorities include advancing FPGA and FPSoC chip architectures, expanding product portfolios across performance and power spectrums, enhancing proprietary EDA software capabilities, developing high-performance IP cores and application reference designs, and cultivating a robust talent pipeline. They also focus on emerging markets like automotive electronics, data centers, and computing acceleration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of FPGA and FPSoC chips and related technical services. The company sells directly and via distributors. They also generate income from licensing and providing dedicated EDA software and application IP solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The FPGA industry is highly concentrated with global leaders AMD (Xilinx) and Intel (Altera) dominating most market share. Anlogic is a leading domestic FPGA chip design company in China, actively expanding its product range and market presence but still in a catch-up phase relative to international giants. They focus on localized innovation and expanding into emerging application fields to strengthen their competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 700.8 million, a 32.75% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to industry downturn and inventory adjustments in downstream markets. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 197.2 million, reflecting a significant decline. R&D expenses increased by 15.82% to RMB 384.2 million, accounting for 54.82% of revenue. The company employs 534 staff, with 444 in R&D, indicating a strong focus on innovation despite financial challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Anlogic emphasizes its comprehensive product portfolio covering a wide range of FPGA and FPSoC chips tailored to diverse application needs, supported by proprietary full-process EDA software and rich application IP libraries. Their products offer high flexibility, low latency, and high integration, meeting stringent requirements in industrial control, automotive, and data center markets. The company also highlights its strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and close customer collaboration to accelerate product adoption and deliver customized solutions.
